terms.definition: A bounded, versioned knowledge record with provenance and a stable identifier.
A directed edge with a named relation type, source, target, and provenance.
A graph that evolves through attributed, versioned observations and explicit relations; it does not invent edges.
Small JSON metadata and extracted text synchronized independently of original media bytes.
A cryptographic digest used to identify exact bytes; it is not compression or semantic understanding.
A locally generated thumbnail, transcript, OCR result, or transcoded rendition with its own provenance and hash.
Core capture and recall continue without a network; remote sync is an explicit optional layer.
A versioned intermediate representation for programs; it does not itself compress photos, documents, or video.
